threshold_selection.diagnostic_note: The validation-only F1 threshold is reported for transparency and is not used to make any model or threshold decision.
threshold_selection.model_threshold_dependence: The model is selected on validation, while the threshold is calibrated from training-only out-of-fold predictions.  The two decisions therefore use different data.  The calibrated threshold assumes the selected model's probability ranking transfers to the train+validation refit.
threshold_selection.note: Each out-of-fold probability comes from a model fitted without the corresponding training record.  The test set was not accessed.  The threshold is fixed before test evaluation; the final pipeline is then refit on train+validation.

model_selection.rule: At the 0.50 reference threshold, require validation recall >= 0.55 and validation precision >= 0.50; among eligible models select the highest validation_pr_auc, breaking ties with validation_f1 and then validation_roc_auc.
